USDTHB, Bitcoin and Nasdaq 100 come from Yahoo (flagged). Bigdata.com is still out of credits, so news is from the web only. Graded: the 23 Nov calls and the Saturday 21 Nov set, both against Monday's bar. USDJPY and 10Y show as losses on the close-to-close move even though neither entry (159.20 / 4.97) filled.
key_risk: Wednesday's core PCE (20:30 ICT) and the 5y/7y auctions (01:00 ICT Wed/Thu) test a December hike that is now ~98% priced after Williams said the Fed has 'work to do' and wouldn't rule out back-to-back hikes. A hot PCE pushes the 2y towards 4.80% and DXY towards 105, which puts USDTHB through 34.00. For THB, the dollar is the driver, not the risk rally.

USDJPY.news: 159.01 (+0.29%). Risk-on (Nvidia +31%) and a 2y +7bp lifted it, but it stalled short of 160 again. Katayama says Tokyo will 'respond appropriately' to one-sided moves, and exporters have moved their offers below 160. Tokyo CPI is due Fri 06:30 ICT; BOJ 18 Dec.
USDJPY.trade: Bearish only at the wall: sell 159.90, stop 160.50, target 158.50. No edge in the middle of 158.5–160.

USDTHB.news: 33.96 (Yahoo, flagged), still pinned just under 34.00 at the weakest baht in ~19 months. DXY at a 6m high is the pressure, and Monday's equity rebound didn't help. BoT 1.00%, MPC 23 Dec; TH CPI (Nov) on 7 Dec.
USDTHB.trade: No call. A close above 34.00 opens 34.20 if PCE is hot.

UST 10Y (%).news: 4.918 (+0.6bp), flat on a +4.7% equity day while the 2y rose ~7bp to ~4.70%: a hawkish flattening. The 2y auction reportedly priced at 4.700% (unconfirmed). Williams: inflation too high, sees 3.5% at end-2026, no preset path. 5y $70B tonight, 7y $44B Wed.
UST 10Y (%).trade: No trade outright. The edge is a 2s10s flattener into PCE; for outright, 4.95/5.03 is resistance and 4.816 support.

DXY (ICE fut).news: 104.26 (Dec fut, +0.50%), a new 6m high above the upper band (RSI 73). Hike pricing went from 88% to 98% while yields elsewhere are capped. It ignored the risk-on day.
DXY (ICE fut).trade: Bullish: buy the dip at 103.70 (prior breakout/S1), stop 103.10, target 105.00. Don't chase at 104.3.

Brent CO1.news: Feb 86.68 (-3.64%), -19% over 1m and below the 20/50DMA (~95.4/96.5). The surplus view (IEA), Middle East flows recovering and fading Iran-strike fear outweigh Houthi and Gulf attacks. Trump says strikes could resume after New Year.
Brent CO1.trade: Bearish: sell the bounce at 89.50, stop 92.20, target 83.00 (82.1 support). Size small: ATR 4.2.
